info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Employee Evaluation Evaluation-spec
info.description: The Employee Evaluation Creation API enables businesses to initiate and submit evaluations for employees within the human resources management system. This endpoint allows for the structured creation of evaluation records, capturing essential data such as performance metrics, feedback, and employee identifiers. It is primarily used by HR professionals and managers to facilitate workforce assessments and development processes. This API offers a streamlined way to enhance employee performance tracking and support organizational growth initiatives.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a new evaluation for an employee, capturing their performance and development feedback. Make sure to include all required evaluation details in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update an employee evaluation within the human resource management system. It includes necessary details such as employee ID, evaluation score, comments, and any other pertinent information required for a comprehensive evaluation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the evaluation data.
